title: The Last Machine Again
author: R. M. Underhill
blurb: Mara Ashgrove, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
